The BF16 and prior KV-only references use different inference protocols; this is not a causal isolation of the attention change. eval.thinking is not injected by this checkout, so chat-template defaults apply.

known_pitfalls: AutoRound ignore_layers matches runtime module names, not necessarily checkpoint tensor prefixes. For the adjacent Mamba layers here, use model.layers.* in the ignore list and verify exported dtypes; the earlier backbone.layers.* attempt quantized 12 protected projections.

The Mamba2 reference fallback attempted a 64 GiB allocation with its default batch. Use --seqlen 2048 --batch_size 1 for this calibrated static-KV run; this is a measured workaround, not a universal Mamba setting.

Verify actual SM120 MXFP8 MoE execution on the final weights and topology. The default Marlin path failed in this environment; explicitly selecting Humming passed the candidate smoke and full evaluation.

The AQA full pipeline did not complete because this checkout cannot restart an external vLLM server between phases. Preserve the failed aqa_run.json as history and use the recorded staged server plus aqa eval artifacts; do not label the original aqa run itself as successful.

On SM120, static FP8 attention requires the tested TRITON_ATTN + FP8 KV path and a runtime check that checkpoint q/k/v scales load and QuantFP8 query quantization is active; exported q_scales alone are not sufficient.
